rs.q: Although the new bridge was expensive to build, it has significantly reduced the time commuters spend traveling between the two cities.
o: Though costly to build, the new bridge has greatly shortened travel time between the two cities.
Because the new bridge was so costly, commuters now spend less time traveling between the two cities.
The new bridge was expensive to build, but it has hardly affected the time commuters spend traveling between the cities.
The new bridge will significantly reduce travel time once its construction costs have been covered.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: נשמרו הניגוד (though = although) והטענה שהגשר קיצר משמעותית את זמן הנסיעה. המסיחים: (2) יצירת קשר סיבה-תוצאה – המחיר הגבוה מוצג כסיבה לקיצור הנסיעה, ובמקור יש ניגוד ולא סיבה; (3) שינוי שלילה – hardly affected הופך את 'קיצר משמעותית'; (4) שינוי זמן – המקור מתאר דבר שכבר קרה, ולא עתיד.

rs.q: Most children who learn a second language before the age of ten are able to speak it without a noticeable foreign accent later in life.
o: All children who learn a second language before the age of ten speak it without any accent as adults.
Most children who learn a second language before ten find it difficult to lose their foreign accent later in life.
Most people who acquire a second language before ten will later speak it with no obvious accent.
Most children who learn a second language before ten also become better at mathematics later in life.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: most נשמר, learn = acquire, later in life = later, without a noticeable accent = with no obvious accent. המסיחים: (1) שינוי כמת – most הפך ל-all; (2) שינוי שלילה – המשמעות הפוכה: נשאר להם מבטא; (4) תוספת מידע – מתמטיקה אינה מוזכרת במקור.

rs.q: The museum rarely displays its collection of ancient manuscripts, since even brief exposure to light can damage the fragile pages.
o: Since even brief exposure to light can harm the delicate pages, the museum seldom shows its ancient manuscripts.
The museum often displays its ancient manuscripts, even though light can damage their fragile pages.
Because the museum rarely displays its ancient manuscripts, their pages have become fragile.
The museum rarely displays its ancient manuscripts, which are its most valuable and popular possessions.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: rarely = seldom, והסיבה (נזק מאור אפילו קצר) נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) שינוי שלילה – rarely הפך ל-often; (3) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – השבריריות היא הסיבה, לא התוצאה; (4) תוספת מידע – ערכם ופופולריותם אינם מוזכרים, והסיבה הושמטה.

rs.q: Scientists believe that the number of honeybees in Europe has declined sharply over the past two decades, mainly because of the widespread use of pesticides.
o: Scientists believe that the number of honeybees in Europe will decline sharply over the next two decades because of pesticides.
Scientists believe that pesticides are the only reason honeybee numbers in Europe have fallen.
Scientists attribute the steep fall in Europe's honeybees over the last twenty years chiefly to pesticides.
Scientists believe that the decline of honeybees in Europe has led to increased pesticide use.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: mainly = chiefly, declined sharply = steep fall, past two decades = last twenty years. המסיחים: (1) שינוי זמן – עבר הפך לעתיד; (2) שינוי כמת – mainly הפך ל-only; (4) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – חומרי ההדברה הם הסיבה לירידה ולא תוצאתה.

rs.q: Unlike his earlier novels, which were widely praised by critics, the author's latest book has received mostly negative reviews since its publication last spring.
o: Like his earlier novels, the author's latest book has been praised by most critics since last spring.
All reviews of the author's latest book have been negative, unlike those of his earlier novels.
The author's latest book received negative reviews because critics had praised his earlier novels too much.
Since last spring, most reviews of the author's new book have been unfavorable, unlike those of his earlier novels.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: נשמרו הניגוד (unlike), הזמן (since last spring) והכמת mostly = most. המסיחים: (1) שינוי כיוון ההשוואה – unlike הפך ל-like והביקורות הפכו לחיוביות; (2) שינוי כמת – mostly הפך ל-all; (3) תוספת מידע – נוסף קשר סיבתי שאינו קיים במקור.

rs.q: According to several recent studies, regular physical exercise not only strengthens the heart but also appears to improve memory and concentration in older adults.
o: Several recent studies show that regular exercise strengthens the heart but does not improve memory in older adults.
Recent studies suggest regular exercise benefits not just the heart but also older people's memory and focus.
All studies prove that regular exercise improves memory and concentration in people of every age.
According to recent studies, older adults with good memory and concentration tend to exercise more regularly.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: not only... but also = not just... but also, appears = suggest, והנושא (מבוגרים) נשמר. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – השיפור בזיכרון נשלל; (3) שינוי כמת – several הפך ל-all, ומבוגרים הפכו ל'כל גיל'; (4) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – הזיכרון מוצג כסיבה לפעילות ולא כתוצאתה.

rs.q: The company decided to postpone the launch of its new smartphone until next year, as several technical problems had not yet been solved.
o: The company launched its new smartphone last year, despite several unsolved technical problems.
The company postponed the smartphone launch, and as a result several technical problems appeared.
The company postponed the launch of its new smartphone because its competitors had released better models.
With several technical issues still unresolved, the company put off its smartphone launch until next year.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: postpone = put off, had not yet been solved = still unresolved, והקשר הסיבתי נשמר. המסיחים: (1) שינוי זמן – ההשקה נדחתה לשנה הבאה, ולא התקיימה בשנה שעברה; (2) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – התקלות הן סיבת הדחייה ולא תוצאתה; (3) תוספת מידע – המתחרים אינם מוזכרים, והסיבה הוחלפה.

rs.q: In many traditional societies, older members of the community were treated with great respect because they were seen as sources of wisdom and experience.
o: In all traditional societies, older members of the community were treated with great respect for their wisdom.
In many traditional societies, older members of the community are still treated with great respect today.
In many traditional societies, people became wise and experienced because the community treated them with respect.
Many traditional societies highly honored their elders, regarding them as sources of wisdom and experience.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: many נשמר, treated with great respect = highly honored, והסיבה נשמרה (regarding them as). המסיחים: (1) שינוי כמת – many הפך ל-all; (2) שינוי זמן – המקור מתאר עבר ואינו אומר דבר על ההווה; (3) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – החוכמה היא סיבת הכבוד ולא תוצאתו.

rs.q: Few people realize that the tomato, now a central ingredient in Italian cooking, was not introduced to Europe until the sixteenth century.
o: Not many people are aware that tomatoes, which are essential to Italian cuisine today, only arrived in Europe in the 1500s.
Many people know that the tomato, a central ingredient in Italian cooking, was introduced to Europe in the sixteenth century.
Few people realize that the tomato was a central ingredient in Italian cooking long before the sixteenth century.
Few people realize that the tomato, first grown in Italy, was later exported to the rest of Europe.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: few = not many, not... until = only, the sixteenth century = the 1500s. המסיחים: (2) שינוי כמת – few הפך ל-many; (3) שינוי זמן – העגבנייה הגיעה לאירופה רק במאה ה-16; (4) תוספת מידע – המקור אינו טוען שגודלה לראשונה באיטליה.

rs.q: Although electric cars produce no exhaust while driving, the electricity used to charge them is often generated by burning fossil fuels.
o: Although electric cars produce no exhaust, the electricity used to charge them is always generated by burning fossil fuels.
Electric cars emit no exhaust on the road, yet the power that charges them frequently comes from fossil fuels.
Because their electricity comes from fossil fuels, electric cars produce no exhaust while driving.
Electric cars cause more pollution than gasoline cars, since their electricity is generated by burning fossil fuels.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: נשמר הניגוד (although = yet) והכמת often = frequently. המסיחים: (1) שינוי כמת – often הפך ל-always; (3) יצירת קשר סיבה-תוצאה – במקור יש ניגוד בין שני הנתונים ולא סיבתיות; (4) תוספת מידע – ההשוואה למכוניות בנזין אינה מופיעה במקור.

rs.q: The festival, which was first held in a small village hall in 1985, now attracts thousands of visitors from around the world every summer.
o: Begun in a small village hall in 1985, the festival now draws thousands of visitors worldwide each summer.
The festival, first held in a small village hall in 1985, attracted thousands of visitors only in its first summer.
The festival attracts thousands of visitors every summer because it is still held in a small village hall.
The festival, first held in a small village hall in 1985, now attracts only a few local visitors each summer.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: כל הפרטים נשמרו: ההתחלה ב-1985 באולם קטן והמבקרים הרבים מכל העולם בהווה. המסיחים: (2) שינוי זמן – ה'עכשיו' הפך לשנה הראשונה בלבד; (3) יצירת קשר סיבה-תוצאה – במקור אין קשר סיבתי, והאולם הקטן שייך לעבר; (4) שינוי כמת – thousands הפך ל-a few.

rs.q: Doctors seldom prescribe antibiotics for the common cold, because these drugs are effective against bacteria but not against the viruses that cause colds.
o: Doctors usually prescribe antibiotics for the common cold, because these drugs are effective against viruses.
As antibiotics fight bacteria but not cold viruses, physicians rarely give them for the common cold.
Because doctors seldom prescribe antibiotics, the viruses that cause colds have become resistant to them.
Doctors never prescribe any medication for the common cold, since colds are caused by viruses.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: seldom = rarely, והסיבה (חיידקים ולא נגיפים) נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – seldom הפך ל-usually, והתרופה מוצגת כיעילה נגד נגיפים; (3) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – נוצרה תוצאה שאינה במקור, והסיבה המקורית התהפכה; (4) שינוי כמת – seldom הפך ל-never ואנטיביוטיקה הפכה ל'כל תרופה'.

rs.q: Compared with city residents, people living in rural areas tend to know their neighbors better but have less access to public services.
o: Compared with rural residents, people in cities tend to know their neighbors better but have less access to public services.
Rural people usually know their neighbors better than city dwellers do but have poorer access to public services.
People in rural areas know their neighbors better because they have less access to public services.
People in rural areas always know all of their neighbors and have no access to public services.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: כיוון ההשוואה נשמר (הכפריים מכירים יותר, ונגישים פחות לשירותים), tend to = usually, less access = poorer access. המסיחים: (1) שינוי כיוון ההשוואה – התושבים העירוניים והכפריים הוחלפו; (3) יצירת קשר סיבה-תוצאה – במקור שתי העובדות מוצגות זו לצד זו, ללא סיבתיות; (4) שינוי כמת – tend to ו-less הפכו ל-always ו-no.

rs.q: The ancient city was abandoned around 900 CE, probably because a long drought made it impossible to grow enough food for its population.
o: The ancient city was definitely abandoned around 900 CE because of a long drought.
Because the city was abandoned around 900 CE, its fields dried up and could no longer produce food.
The city was probably deserted around 900 CE because a long drought left too little food.
The ancient city, abandoned around 900 CE, was rebuilt by its inhabitants once the drought ended.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: probably נשמר, abandoned = deserted, והשרשרת הסיבתית (בצורת ← מחסור במזון ← נטישה) נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי מידת הוודאות – probably הפך ל-definitely; (2) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – הבצורת גרמה לנטישה, ולא להפך; (4) תוספת מידע – המקור אינו מזכיר בנייה מחדש.

rs.q: Many economists argue that a moderate rise in the minimum wage would improve the living conditions of low-paid workers without significantly increasing unemployment.
o: Many economists argue that a moderate rise in the minimum wage would greatly increase unemployment among low-paid workers.
All economists agree that a rise in the minimum wage would improve the living conditions of workers.
Numerous economists hold that a modest minimum-wage rise would help low-paid workers without much added unemployment.
Many economists argue that last year's moderate rise in the minimum wage improved the living conditions of low-paid workers.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: many = numerous, moderate = modest, without significantly increasing = without much added. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – without increasing הפך ל'יגדיל מאוד'; (2) שינוי כמת – many הפך ל-all; (4) שינוי זמן – המקור מדבר על העלאה אפשרית (would), לא על העלאה שכבר התרחשה.

rs.q: While the printing press is often credited with spreading literacy throughout Europe, historians point out that reading rates rose only gradually, as books remained too expensive for most families for centuries.
o: Historians point out that the printing press immediately made books cheap enough for most European families, so reading rates rose rapidly.
Historians argue that the printing press played no role in spreading literacy, since books were too expensive.
Though the press is often credited with spreading literacy, historians note reading rose slowly as books long stayed unaffordable.
Historians point out that because reading rates rose slowly, books remained too expensive for most families.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: נשמרו הניגוד, ההדרגתיות (only gradually = slowly) והסיבה (מחיר הספרים). המסיחים: (1) שינוי זמן – התהליך ההדרגתי הוצג כמיידי; (2) שינוי שלילה – ההיסטוריונים אינם שוללים את תרומת הדפוס אלא רק מסייגים את קצב ההשפעה; (4) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – המחיר הגבוה הוא הסיבה לקצב האיטי, ולא להפך.

rs.q: Contrary to popular belief, sharks rarely attack humans, and when they do, it is usually because they mistake a swimmer for a seal or other natural prey.
o: As most people believe, sharks often attack humans, usually because they mistake swimmers for seals or other prey.
Sharks rarely attack humans, but when they do it is invariably because they mistake a swimmer for a seal or other prey.
Sharks rarely attack humans, but they attack seals more often than any other animal.
Despite common belief, shark attacks on people are rare and usually result from sharks mistaking swimmers for seals or other prey.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: contrary to popular belief = despite common belief, rarely = rare, usually נשמר. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – rarely הפך ל-often, וגם האמונה הרווחת מוצגת כנכונה; (2) שינוי כמת – usually הפך ל-invariably (תמיד); (3) תוספת מידע – המקור אינו משווה בין קורבנות שונים של כרישים.

rs.q: The researchers found that participants who slept fewer than six hours a night were significantly more likely to catch a cold after exposure to the virus than those who slept seven hours or more.
o: The researchers found that participants who slept seven hours or more were more likely to catch a cold than those who slept fewer than six hours.
In the study, those sleeping under six hours a night caught colds after virus exposure far more often than those sleeping seven or more.
The researchers found that catching a cold caused participants to sleep fewer than six hours a night.
The researchers found that all participants who slept fewer than six hours caught a cold after exposure to the virus.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: כיוון ההשוואה (ישנים מעט ← חולים יותר) נשמר, ו-significantly more likely = far more often. המסיחים: (1) שינוי כיוון ההשוואה – הקבוצות הוחלפו; (3) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – מיעוט השינה קודם להצטננות ולא נגרם ממנה; (4) שינוי כמת – more likely הפך ל-all.

rs.q: Not until the invention of the telescope in the early seventeenth century were astronomers able to observe that the planet Jupiter is orbited by moons of its own.
o: Long before the telescope was invented, astronomers had already observed that Jupiter is orbited by moons.
Only once the telescope was invented in the early 1600s could astronomers see that Jupiter has moons.
Astronomers invented the telescope in the early seventeenth century in order to observe the moons of Jupiter.
Even after the telescope was invented, astronomers were unable to observe that Jupiter has moons.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: not until = only once, והמבנה ההפוך (were astronomers able) תורגם נכון. המסיחים: (1) שינוי זמן – התצפית הוקדמה לתקופה שלפני הטלסקופ; (3) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – הטלסקופ איפשר את התצפית, ולא הומצא בגללה; (4) שינוי שלילה – היכולת לצפות נשללה.

rs.q: Although bilingual children may initially take longer to build their vocabulary in each language, they often catch up with their monolingual peers by the time they start school.
o: Bilingual children may be slower at first to build vocabulary in each language but often catch up with monolingual peers by school age.
Bilingual children build their vocabulary faster than monolingual children at first, and this advantage often remains once they start school.
Bilingual children take longer to build their vocabulary and rarely catch up with monolingual peers by school age.
Bilingual children always catch up with their monolingual peers in vocabulary before they start school.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: may initially take longer = may be slower at first, often נשמר, by the time they start school = by school age. המסיחים: (2) שינוי כיוון ההשוואה – דו-לשוניים מוצגים כמהירים יותר; (3) שינוי שלילה – often catch up הפך ל-rarely catch up; (4) שינוי כמת – often הפך ל-always.

rs.q: The government's decision to lower interest rates was intended to encourage borrowing and investment, but it also contributed to a sharp increase in housing prices in major cities.
o: Rate cuts meant to spur borrowing and investment also helped push big-city house prices sharply up.
The government lowered interest rates mainly in order to raise housing prices in the country's major cities.
The sharp rise in housing prices in major cities led the government to lower interest rates.
The decision to lower interest rates encouraged borrowing but had no effect on housing prices.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: intended = meant, ועליית מחירי הדיור נשמרה כתוצאת לוואי (also helped push) ולא כמטרה. המסיחים: (2) הצגת תוצאה כמטרה – עליית המחירים הייתה תוצאת לוואי, לא המטרה; (3) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – הורדת הריבית קדמה לעליית המחירים ותרמה לה; (4) שינוי שלילה – ההשפעה על מחירי הדיור נשללה.

rs.q: Although Vincent van Gogh produced more than two thousand works of art, he sold very few paintings during his lifetime and achieved fame only after his death.
o: Van Gogh created over two thousand works yet sold hardly any while alive, winning fame only after his death.
Van Gogh sold most of his more than two thousand works during his lifetime and became famous after his death.
Van Gogh produced more than two thousand works and was already famous during his lifetime.
Van Gogh sold very few paintings because he produced too many works for the art market to absorb.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: very few = hardly any, during his lifetime = while alive, והתהילה נשארה לאחר המוות. המסיחים: (2) שינוי כמת – very few הפך ל-most; (3) שינוי זמן – התהילה הוקדמה לחייו; (4) יצירת קשר סיבה-תוצאה – נוסף הסבר סיבתי שאינו במקור.

rs.q: Studies of identical twins raised apart suggest that genetic factors play a larger role in shaping personality than was assumed by psychologists in the mid-twentieth century.
o: Studies of twins raised apart suggest that genes play a smaller role in personality than mid-twentieth-century psychologists assumed.
Twin studies suggest heredity shapes personality more than mid-twentieth-century psychologists believed.
Studies of twins raised apart prove that personality is determined entirely by genetic factors.
Psychologists in the mid-twentieth century already assumed that genes were the main factor shaping personality.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: כיוון ההשוואה (larger than was assumed = more than believed) ומידת הוודאות (suggest) נשמרו. המסיחים: (1) שינוי כיוון ההשוואה – larger הפך ל-smaller; (3) שינוי כמת – 'תפקיד גדול יותר' הפך ל'באופן מוחלט', ו-suggest הפך ל-prove; (4) שינוי זמן – הממצא החדש מיוחס לפסיכולוגים של העבר, בניגוד למקור.

rs.q: Hardly any of the species that live in the deep ocean have been studied in their natural habitat, since the extreme pressure there makes exploration both difficult and costly.
o: Most deep-ocean species have been studied in their natural habitat, despite the extreme pressure there.
Because so few deep-ocean species have been studied, the pressure in the deep ocean is difficult to measure.
Hardly any deep-ocean species have been studied in their habitat, since most of them are too small to be seen without a microscope.
Since deep-sea pressure makes research hard and costly, very few deep-ocean species have been studied where they live.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: hardly any = very few, והסיבה (לחץ ← קושי ועלות) נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – hardly any הפך ל-most; (2) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – הלחץ הוא הסיבה למיעוט המחקר, ולא להפך; (3) תוספת מידע – הסיבה הוחלפה בסיבה שאינה במקור.

rs.q: In the nineteenth century, many European cities built extensive sewer systems, a development that did more to reduce deaths from cholera than any medical treatment available at the time.
o: In the nineteenth century, medical treatments did more to reduce cholera deaths than the new sewer systems.
The decline in cholera deaths in the nineteenth century allowed many European cities to build extensive sewer systems.
Nineteenth-century sewers in many European cities cut cholera deaths more than any medical treatment of the day.
All European cities built sewer systems in the nineteenth century, which completely eliminated cholera.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: כיוון ההשוואה (הביוב השפיע יותר מכל טיפול רפואי) והכמת many נשמרו. המסיחים: (1) שינוי כיוון ההשוואה – הטיפול הרפואי מוצג כיעיל יותר; (2) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – מערכות הביוב גרמו לירידה בתמותה, ולא להפך; (4) שינוי כמת – many הפך ל-all, ו'הפחית' הפך ל'חיסל לגמרי'.

rs.q: In her new book, the author argues that social media has not so much created political polarization as amplified divisions that already existed within society long before the internet.
o: In her new book, the author argues that social media is the original cause of political polarization.

Few tourists visit the northern village in winter, so the only road leading to it is rarely cleared of snow.
