rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: as = because, blocks = cuts off, few tourists visit = draws few tourists, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) שינוי כמת – few הפך ל-many; (3) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – השלג הוא הסיבה למיעוט התיירים, ולא תוצאה שלו; (4) שינוי מידת ודאות – often blocks הפך לסגירה קבועה ו-few ל-no.

rs.q: The new medication is not recommended for children under twelve, because its long-term effects on young patients have not yet been studied.
o: The new medication is recommended for children under twelve, although its long-term effects have not been studied.
As its long-term impact on young patients remains unexamined, the drug is not advised for children below twelve.
Long-term studies have shown that the new medication harms children under twelve.
The long-term effects of the new medication have not been studied because it is not recommended for children.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: not recommended = not advised, have not yet been studied = remains unexamined, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – not recommended הפך ל-recommended; (3) תוספת מידע – במקור ההשפעות כלל לא נחקרו, ולא הוכח נזק; (4) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – היעדר המחקר הוא הסיבה לאי-ההמלצה, ולא התוצאה.

rs.q: Researchers have found that people who live near green spaces report lower levels of stress than those who live in densely built neighborhoods.
o: Researchers have found that people who live near green spaces report higher levels of stress than those in dense neighborhoods.
Researchers have found that green spaces are being built in dense neighborhoods in order to reduce stress among residents.
Researchers have proven that living near green spaces completely prevents stress.
According to researchers, residents of crowded built-up areas report more stress than people living close to green spaces.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: lower stress than = (the others report) more stress, densely built = crowded built-up, near = close to, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי השוואה – lower הפך ל-higher; (2) תוספת מידע – בניית שטחים ירוקים אינה מוזכרת במקור; (3) שינוי מידת ודאות – דיווח על לחץ נמוך יותר הפך להוכחה שהלחץ נמנע לחלוטין.

rs.q: It was not until the late nineteenth century that most homes in the city were connected to a public water supply.
o: By the early nineteenth century, most homes in the city were already connected to a public water supply.
In the late nineteenth century, a few homes in the city were connected to a public water supply for the first time.
Only in the late 1800s did the majority of the city's homes gain access to a public water supply.
In the late nineteenth century, the city built a public water supply in order to attract new residents.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: it was not until = only in, most = the majority, were connected = gain access, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי זמן – סוף המאה הפך לתחילתה; (2) שינוי כמת – most הפך ל-a few; (4) תוספת מידע – המטרה למשוך תושבים אינה מוזכרת במקור.

rs.q: The singer canceled the rest of her tour after injuring her ankle, although she had already performed in more than half of the planned cities.
o: The singer injured her ankle after canceling the rest of her tour in more than half of the planned cities.
The singer continued her tour despite injuring her ankle, and she went on to perform in more than half of the planned cities.
Injured in the ankle, the singer called off the rest of her tour, having already played over half its cities.
Because of an ankle injury, the singer canceled her tour before performing in any of the planned cities.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: canceled = called off, after injuring = injured, although she had already performed = having already played, more than half = over half, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – הפציעה היא שגרמה לביטול, וסדר האירועים התהפך; (2) שינוי שלילה – canceled הפך ל-continued; (4) שינוי כמת – more than half הפך ל-none.

rs.q: Students who submit their assignments after the deadline will lose points unless they have received written permission from the lecturer in advance.
o: Late work will cost students points unless the lecturer gave written approval beforehand.
Students who submit their assignments late will lose points even if the lecturer gave them permission in advance.
The lecturer will give permission to students who lose points for submitting their assignments late.
Students who submit their assignments late may sometimes lose points, depending on the lecturer's mood.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: after the deadline = late, lose points = cost points, permission = approval, in advance = beforehand, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) שינוי שלילה – unless הפך ל-even if, כלומר האישור כבר אינו פוטר; (3) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – האישור קודם ומונע את הורדת הנקודות, ולא בא בעקבותיה; (4) שינוי מידת ודאות – will lose הפך ל-may sometimes, ונוסף מצב הרוח של המרצה.

rs.q: Hardly anyone in the town knew about the old tunnel until a group of children discovered its entrance while playing in the woods.
o: Almost nobody in town knew of the old tunnel before children playing in the woods found its entrance.
Most people in the town knew about the old tunnel, but only children were allowed to play near its entrance.
Hardly anyone in the town knew about the old tunnel, even after a group of children discovered its entrance.
The children went into the woods in order to find the entrance to the old tunnel.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: hardly anyone = almost nobody, until = before, discovered = found, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) שינוי כמת – hardly anyone הפך ל-most; (3) שינוי זמן – until הפך ל-even after, כלומר המצב לא השתנה לאחר הגילוי; (4) הצגת תוצאה כמטרה – הגילוי היה מקרי במהלך משחק, ולא מטרת היציאה.

rs.q: The more time teenagers spend looking at their phones before going to bed, the less likely they are to get enough sleep on school nights.
o: The more teenagers sleep, the less time they spend on their phones before bed.
Teenagers who spend time on their phones before bed never get enough sleep.
The more time teenagers spend on their phones before bed, the more likely they are to sleep well on school nights.
Teens who use their phones longer before bed are less likely to sleep enough on school nights.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: the more ... the less likely = longer ... less likely, get enough sleep = sleep enough, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – השימוש בטלפון הוא הגורם, והשינה היא התוצאה; (2) שינוי מידת ודאות – less likely הפך ל-never; (3) שינוי השוואה – the less הפך ל-the more.

rs.q: The factory was closed by the authorities last month because it had repeatedly released polluted water into the nearby river.
o: The factory released polluted water into the nearby river after it was closed by the authorities last month.
The factory's owners decided to close it last month after polluted water was found in the river.
The factory was closed last month because it had once released a small amount of polluted water into the river.
Last month officials shut the factory down over its repeated discharge of contaminated water into the river nearby.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: authorities = officials, closed = shut down, polluted = contaminated, repeatedly = repeated, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי זמן – הזיהום קדם לסגירה ולא בא אחריה; (2) החלפת נושא – הרשויות סגרו את המפעל, לא בעליו; (3) שינוי כמת – repeatedly הפך ל-once.

rs.q: Although the restaurant is located far from the city center and is not easy to reach by bus, it is almost always full on weekends.
o: Because the restaurant is located far from the city center and is hard to reach by bus, it is rarely full on weekends.
Though far from downtown and hard to reach by bus, the restaurant is nearly always packed on weekends.
The restaurant is almost always full on weekends because it is far from the noisy city center.
Although the restaurant is far from the city center, it is full every day of the week.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: although = though, city center = downtown, not easy = hard, almost always = nearly always, full = packed, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – almost always הפך ל-rarely; (3) יצירת קשר סיבתי – המרחק מוצג כסיבה להצלחה, ובמקור יש ניגוד; (4) שינוי כמת – almost always on weekends הפך ל-every day.

rs.q: Not all of the paintings in the exhibition were created by the famous artist; several were produced by students working in his studio.
o: All of the paintings in the exhibition were created by the famous artist with the help of his students.
Some of the exhibition's paintings were made by students in the famous artist's studio rather than by the artist himself.
The famous artist taught several students in his studio in order to produce paintings for the exhibition.
The famous artist created several paintings in the exhibition, which were later copied by students in his studio.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: not all = some were not, several = some, produced = made, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי כמת – not all הפך ל-all; (3) הצגת תוצאה כמטרה – במקור אין טענה שזו הייתה מטרת ההוראה; (4) תוספת מידע – העתקת הציורים אינה מוזכרת במקור.

rs.q: The government plans to raise the tax on sugary drinks next year in order to reduce the rate of obesity among young people.
o: The government raised the tax on sugary drinks last year, which reduced obesity among young people.
The government plans to raise the tax on sugary drinks next year, which will certainly eliminate obesity among young people.
To lower obesity rates among the young, the government intends to increase the tax on sweetened beverages next year.
Young people plan to drink fewer sugary drinks next year in order to reduce obesity.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: plans = intends, raise = increase, in order to reduce = to lower, sugary drinks = sweetened beverages, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי זמן – תוכנית לשנה הבאה הפכה לעובדה מהשנה שעברה; (2) שינוי מידת ודאות – מטרה הפכה לתוצאה ודאית; (4) החלפת נושא – הממשלה מתכננת, לא הצעירים.

rs.q: Scarcely any of the letters the poet wrote to his sister have survived, since most of them were destroyed in a fire after his death.
o: Most of the letters the poet wrote to his sister have survived, although some were damaged in a fire.
The poet destroyed most of the letters to his sister in a fire before his death.
Scarcely any of the poet's letters to his sister survived because he rarely wrote to her.
Very few of the poet's letters to his sister still exist, as the majority were burned in a fire following his death.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: scarcely any = very few, have survived = still exist, most = the majority, after = following, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – scarcely any הפך ל-most; (2) החלפת נושא – המשורר מוצג כמי שהשמיד את המכתבים, ולפני מותו; (3) יצירת קשר סיבתי – הסיבה במקור היא השריפה, לא מיעוט כתיבה.

rs.q: Children who eat a healthy breakfast regularly tend to perform better at school than those who often skip the morning meal altogether.
o: Kids who often skip breakfast tend to do worse in school than those who regularly eat a healthy one.
Children who perform well at school tend to eat breakfast regularly because they are more organized.
Children who often skip the morning meal altogether tend to perform better at school than those who eat breakfast regularly.
All children who eat breakfast regularly get the highest grades in their class.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: tend to perform better = (the others) tend to do worse, children = kids, at school = in school, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – ההישגים מוצגים כגורם לאכילת ארוחת הבוקר; (3) שינוי השוואה – כיוון ההשוואה התהפך; (4) שינוי כמת – tend to perform better הפך ל-all ... the highest grades.

rs.q: The island's population has doubled over the past twenty years, mainly because many young families have moved there from the mainland.
o: The island's population is expected to double over the next twenty years as young families move there from the mainland.
Many young families have moved to the island from the mainland because its population has doubled.
The island's population has doubled over the past twenty years, mainly because of a sharp rise in tourism.
Mostly thanks to young families arriving from the mainland, the island's population has doubled in twenty years.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: mainly because = mostly thanks to, moved there = arriving, over the past twenty years = in twenty years, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי זמן – תהליך שכבר קרה מוצג כצפי לעתיד; (2) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – המעבר הוא הסיבה לגידול, לא התוצאה שלו; (3) תוספת מידע – תיירות אינה מוזכרת במקור, והסיבה המקורית הושמטה.

rs.q: No sooner had the annual meeting started than the fire alarm went off, forcing everyone to leave the building and wait outside in the rain.
o: The fire alarm went off shortly before the annual meeting started, so everyone left the building and waited outside.
Right after the annual meeting began, the fire alarm sounded, and everyone had to go out and wait in the rain.
The meeting started late because the fire alarm had forced everyone to leave the building.
No sooner had the meeting started than some people chose to leave the building to avoid the fire alarm.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: no sooner ... than = right after, went off = sounded, forcing = had to, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי זמן – האזעקה נשמעה אחרי תחילת הישיבה, לא לפניה; (3) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – האזעקה לא עיכבה את הישיבה אלא הפסיקה אותה; (4) שינוי כמת – everyone was forced הפך ל-some chose.

rs.q: Many experts doubt that the new law will have any real effect on air quality, since it applies only to a small number of factories.
o: Many experts are confident that the new law will greatly improve air quality in the region.
The new law applies only to a small number of factories because many experts doubt its effect on air quality.
Few experts doubt that the new law will affect air quality, even though it applies to a small number of factories.
As the new law covers just a few factories, numerous specialists question whether it will meaningfully improve air quality.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: doubt = question whether, only a small number = just a few, applies to = covers, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי מידת ודאות – doubt הפך ל-confident; (2) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – היקף החוק הוא הסיבה לספק, לא התוצאה; (3) שינוי כמת – many הפך ל-few.

rs.q: The old railway station, which was built more than a century ago, still serves thousands of passengers every day despite its narrow platforms.
o: Because its platforms are narrow, the old railway station serves only a few passengers every day.
The old railway station, built more than a century ago, used to serve thousands of passengers every day.
The century-old station still serves thousands of passengers daily, though its platforms are narrow.
The old railway station's platforms were made narrow in order to serve thousands of passengers every day.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: despite = though, built more than a century ago = century-old, every day = daily, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי כמת – thousands הפך ל-a few, ונוסף קשר סיבתי; (2) שינוי זמן – still serves הפך ל-used to serve; (4) הצגת תוצאה כמטרה – הרציפים הצרים הם קושי, לא אמצעי למטרה.

rs.q: Seldom do young birds of this species survive their first winter in the mountains without the constant protection of both of their parents.
o: Young birds of this species often survive their first winter in the mountains, even without the constant protection of their parents.
Without both parents' constant protection, the young of this species rarely survive their first mountain winter.
Parents of this species seldom protect their young during their first winter.
Young birds of this species never survive their first winter, even with the protection of their parents.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: seldom = rarely, young birds = the young, without the protection of both parents = without both parents' protection, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – seldom הפך ל-often; (3) החלפת נושא – seldom מיוחס להורים במקום לגוזלים; (4) שינוי מידת ודאות – seldom הפך ל-never, וגם ההגנה כבר לא עוזרת.

rs.q: The company hired two hundred new workers last year, yet it still struggled to meet the growing demand for its products.
o: Because the company hired two hundred new workers last year, it easily met the growing demand for its products.
Even after adding two hundred employees last year, the company had difficulty keeping up with rising demand for its goods.
The company will hire two hundred new workers next year to meet the growing demand for its products.
The company's customers struggled to find its products, so it hired two hundred new workers last year.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: yet = even after, struggled = had difficulty, growing = rising, workers = employees, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) פירוש שגוי של הוויתור – yet still struggled הפך ל-easily met; (3) שינוי זמן – הגיוס כבר בוצע בשנה שעברה; (4) החלפת נושא – החברה התקשתה, לא הלקוחות.

rs.q: If the weather remains dry for another week, farmers in the region may lose a large part of their wheat crop.
o: Farmers in the region will certainly lose their entire wheat crop because of the dry weather.
If the weather remains dry for another week, farmers in the region may lose a small part of their wheat crop.
Another week without rain could cost the region's farmers much of their wheat harvest.
Farmers in the region lost a large part of their wheat crop last week because the weather was dry.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: if dry for another week = another week without rain, may = could, a large part = much, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי מידת ודאות – may הפך ל-certainly והתנאי הושמט; (2) שינוי כמת – a large part הפך ל-a small part; (4) שינוי זמן – אפשרות עתידית הוצגה כעובדה שקרתה.

rs.q: Unlike most of his classmates, who chose to study medicine or law, Daniel decided to become a carpenter after finishing high school.
o: Like most of his classmates, Daniel decided to study medicine or law at university after finishing high school.
Daniel decided to become a carpenter because most of his classmates had chosen medicine or law.
Few of Daniel's classmates chose medicine or law; most of them, like him, became carpenters.
Daniel became a carpenter after high school, unlike most of his classmates, who chose medicine or law.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: decided to become a carpenter = became a carpenter, finishing high school = after high school, unlike = unlike (נשמר), והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי השוואה – unlike הפך ל-like; (2) יצירת קשר סיבתי – במקור אין קשר סיבתי, רק ניגוד; (3) שינוי כמת – most הפך ל-few.

rs.q: The vaccine is believed to protect against several strains of the virus, although scientists are still testing how long its effect lasts.
o: Scientists believe the vaccine protects against several virus strains but are still checking how long it works.
The vaccine has been proven to protect against all strains of the virus for many years.
Scientists are testing how long the vaccine lasts because it does not protect against several strains of the virus.
Although scientists believe the vaccine protects against several strains, they have stopped testing how long its effect lasts.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: is believed = believe, although = but, testing = checking, how long its effect lasts = how long it works, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) שינוי מידת ודאות – is believed הפך ל-proven, ונקבע משך ידוע; (3) שינוי שלילה – המקור טוען שהחיסון כן מגן, ונוסף קשר סיבתי; (4) שינוי זמן – still testing הפך ל-stopped.

rs.q: Because the museum's entrance fee was reduced by half last year, the number of family visitors has risen considerably, according to its annual report.
o: The museum reduced its entrance fee last year because the number of family visitors had risen considerably.
Although the museum's entrance fee was reduced last year, the number of family visitors has fallen.
According to its annual report, halving the museum's entrance fee last year has brought in many more family visitors.
The museum reduced its entrance fee by half last year in order to attract more tourists from abroad, according to its annual report.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: reduced by half = halving, risen considerably = many more, because = (the halving) has brought, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – הוזלת המחיר היא הסיבה לעלייה, לא התוצאה; (2) שינוי שלילה – risen הפך ל-fallen; (4) תוספת מידע – תיירים מחו"ל אינם מוזכרים במקור.

rs.q: Only a few of the novels written in that period are still read today, as most of them dealt with issues that no longer interest modern readers.
o: Most of the novels written in that period are still widely read today because of the issues they dealt with.
Modern readers are no longer interested in the issues of that period because they rarely read its novels.
Since most novels from that era focused on topics modern readers no longer care about, only a small number are still read.
Only a few of the novels from that period are still read today, as most of them were too long for modern readers.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: only a few = only a small number, dealt with = focused on, interest = care about, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי כמת – only a few הפך ל-most; (2) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – חוסר העניין הוא הסיבה למיעוט הקריאה, לא התוצאה; (4) תוספת מידע – אורך הספרים אינו מוזכר, והסיבה המקורית הוחלפה.

rs.q: The coach insisted that the players train outdoors even on cold and rainy days, believing that difficult conditions would make them stronger.
o: Believing hardship would toughen them, the coach made the players train outside even in cold rain.
The players insisted on training on rainy days, believing that difficult conditions would make them stronger.
The coach canceled training on rainy days, believing that difficult conditions might harm the players.
The coach made the players train on rainy days, and as a result they became the strongest team in the league.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: insisted = made, difficult conditions = hardship, make them stronger = toughen them, outdoors = outside, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) החלפת נושא – המאמן התעקש, לא השחקנים; (3) שינוי שלילה – insisted on training הפך ל-canceled; (4) תוספת מידע – במקור אין מידע על התוצאה בליגה.

rs.q: Not only did the new irrigation system reduce water consumption on the farm, but it also increased the yield of several crops.
o: The new irrigation system increased the yield of several crops, but it also raised water consumption on the farm.
Besides cutting the farm's water use, the new irrigation system raised the output of a number of crops.
By reducing water consumption, the new irrigation system increased the yield of all the crops on the farm.
The farm reduced its water consumption in order to increase the yield of several crops.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: not only ... but also = besides, reduce = cut, yield = output, several = a number of, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – reduce הפך ל-raised, כך שהיתרון הראשון הפך לחיסרון; (3) שינוי כמת – several הפך ל-all, ונוסף קשר סיבתי בין שני היתרונות; (4) הצגת תוצאה כמטרה – שתי התוצאות של המערכת הוצגו כאמצעי ומטרה.

rs.q: Had the warning been issued earlier, many of the residents could have left the area before the floodwaters reached their homes.
o: Since the warning came late, many residents couldn't leave before the flood reached their homes.
The warning was issued early enough, so many residents managed to leave the area before the floodwaters arrived.
If the warning is issued earlier next time, all residents will leave the area before the flood.
Many residents ignored the early warning and stayed in their homes until the floodwaters arrived.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: had been issued earlier = (in fact) came late, could have left = (in fact) couldn't leave, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) שינוי שלילה – משפט תנאי בלתי ממשי פורש כעובדה: האזהרה דווקא איחרה; (3) שינוי זמן – המקור עוסק באירוע שהיה, ו-many הפך ל-all; (4) תוספת מידע – התעלמות מהאזהרה אינה מוזכרת, והאזהרה לא הייתה מוקדמת.

rs.q: While the theory explains the behavior of most known particles, it fails to account for a small group whose properties remain puzzling.
o: The theory explains the behavior of all known particles, including a small group with puzzling properties.
Because a small group of particles has puzzling properties, the theory fails to explain most known particles.
The theory accounts for the majority of known particles but cannot explain a few whose characteristics are still unclear.
The theory explains only a small group of particles, while the behavior of most of them remains puzzling.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: while = but, most = the majority, fails to account for = cannot explain, puzzling = unclear, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי כמת – most הפך ל-all; (2) יצירת קשר סיבתי – נוצר קשר סיבתי שאינו במקור, ו-most מוצג כמה שאינו מוסבר; (4) החלפת נושא – הקבוצה המוסברת והקבוצה הלא-מוסברת הוחלפו.

rs.q: Hardly had the company announced its innovative new product when several competitors began releasing cheaper versions of it in stores around the country.
o: Long after the company announced its innovative new product, several competitors finally released cheaper versions in stores.
The company announced its new product in order to prevent competitors from releasing cheaper versions.
Right after the firm unveiled its new product, several rivals began selling cheaper copies nationwide.
The company announced its new product because competitors had begun releasing cheaper versions.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: hardly ... when = right after, announced = unveiled, competitors = rivals, around the country = nationwide, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי זמן – hardly ... when מציין מיידיות, לא זמן רב; (2) הצגת תוצאה כמטרה – המקור מתאר רצף אירועים, לא מטרה; (4) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – פעולת המתחרים באה אחרי ההכרזה, לא גרמה לה.

rs.q: Although critics praised the film's photography, most of them agreed that its plot was too slow to hold the audience's attention.
o: Critics liked the film's camerawork, but most felt its slow plot failed to hold viewers' attention.
Because the film's photography was so beautiful, most critics found its slow plot easy to follow.
Critics criticized the film's photography, but most of them praised its slow and thoughtful plot.
A few critics agreed that the film's plot was too slow, although all of them praised its photography.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: although = but, praised = liked, photography = camerawork, agreed = felt, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) פירוש שגוי של הוויתור – הוויתור פורש כסיבה, והביקורת על העלילה נעלמה; (3) שינוי שלילה – השבח והביקורת התהפכו; (4) שינוי כמת – most הפך ל-a few.

rs.q: The study suggests that moderate coffee consumption may lower the risk of certain heart diseases, though further research is needed to confirm this.
o: Moderate coffee drinking might cut the risk of some heart diseases, the study suggests, but this needs confirming.
The study proves that moderate coffee consumption prevents all heart diseases.
The study suggests that heavy coffee consumption may lower the risk of certain heart diseases, though more research is needed.
Further research has confirmed that moderate coffee consumption raises the risk of certain heart diseases.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: may = might, lower = cut, certain = some, further research is needed to confirm = needs confirming, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) שינוי מידת ודאות – suggests/may הפך ל-proves, ו-certain ל-all; (3) שינוי כמת – moderate הפך ל-heavy; (4) שינוי שלילה – lower הפך ל-raises, והמחקר הנוסף טרם נעשה.

rs.q: It was only after the old factory closed that residents realized how much the town's economy had depended on it.
o: Residents did not grasp the extent of the town's economic reliance on the old factory until it shut down.
Residents realized how much the town depended on the old factory, so they tried to keep it open.
The old factory closed because residents realized how little the town's economy depended on it.
Before the old factory closed, residents were well aware of how much the town's economy relied on it.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: only after = not until, realized = grasp, depended on = reliance, closed = shut down, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) תוספת מידע – ניסיון להשאיר את המפעל פתוח אינו מוזכר, וההבנה הגיעה רק לאחר הסגירה; (3) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – ההבנה היא תוצאת הסגירה, ו-how much הפך ל-how little; (4) שינוי זמן – only after הפך ל-before.

rs.q: The more a minority language is used in online communication and social media, the more likely it is to survive among younger generations.
o: The more younger generations use a language, the more it is used in online communication.
Languages that are used in online communication will certainly survive among younger generations.
The less a language is used online, the more likely younger generations are to preserve it.
Minority languages used more online have a better chance of lasting among young people.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: the more ... the more likely = used more ... a better chance, survive = lasting, younger generations = young people, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – השימוש ברשת הוא הגורם, וההישרדות היא התוצאה; (2) שינוי מידת ודאות – more likely הפך ל-certainly; (3) שינוי השוואה – כיוון הקשר התהפך.

rs.q: Many ancient Greek texts survived only because Arab scholars translated them during the Middle Ages, when the originals were being lost in Europe.
o: Arab scholars translated ancient Greek texts in the Middle Ages because the originals had survived well in Europe.
All of the ancient Greek texts that exist today were translated by Arab scholars during the Middle Ages, when the originals were lost in Europe.
European scholars translated many ancient Greek texts into Arabic during the Middle Ages to save them from being lost.
Many Greek classics survive solely because medieval Arab scholars translated them while Europe was losing the originals.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: only because = solely because, during the Middle Ages = medieval, being lost = losing, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – the originals were being lost הפך ל-had survived well; (2) שינוי כמת – many הפך ל-all; (3) החלפת נושא – המתרגמים היו מלומדים ערבים, לא אירופים.

rs.q: Unless the city invests heavily in public transport, traffic congestion is expected to worsen considerably as the population continues to grow over the next decade.
o: Without heavy public-transport investment, congestion will likely rise sharply as the city grows in the coming decade.
Traffic congestion will worsen considerably over the next decade even if the city invests heavily in public transport.
The city's population is growing because it has invested in public transport.
Because the city has invested in public transport, traffic congestion has eased as the population has grown.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: unless = without, is expected to = will likely, worsen considerably = rise sharply, over the next decade = in the coming decade, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) שינוי שלילה – unless הפך ל-even if; (3) יצירת קשר סיבתי – אין במקור קשר סיבתי בין התחבורה לגידול האוכלוסייה; (4) שינוי זמן – תנאי עתידי הוצג כעובדה שכבר קרתה.

rs.q: Contrary to what many people assume, most of the heat lost from a house escapes through its roof and walls rather than through its windows.
o: As many people correctly assume, most of the heat lost from a house in winter escapes through its windows.
Most people assume that a house's roof and walls are better insulated than its windows.
Contrary to common belief, a house loses more heat through its roof and walls than its windows.
Only a little heat escapes through a house's roof and walls compared with its windows.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: what many people assume = common belief, most ... rather than = more ... than, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – contrary to הפך ל-as, והחלונות מוצגים כמקור העיקרי; (2) תוספת מידע – המקור אינו עוסק בבידוד ואינו מציין מה בדיוק אנשים מניחים; (4) שינוי השוואה – כיוון ההשוואה התהפך.

rs.q: Scientists were surprised to find that the bacteria, which normally die within hours outside the body, had survived on the surface for several weeks.
o: Scientists were surprised that the bacteria died within hours after being placed on the surface.
To the scientists' surprise, the bacteria, which usually die within hours outside the body, had survived on the surface for weeks.
Scientists were surprised to find that the bacteria, which had survived on the surface for weeks, resisted all known drugs.
The bacteria survived on the surface for several weeks because scientists kept them outside the body.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: were surprised = to the scientists' surprise, normally = usually, several weeks = weeks, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – survived for weeks הפך ל-died within hours; (3) תוספת מידע – עמידות לתרופות אינה מוזכרת במקור; (4) יצירת קשר סיבתי – נוצר קשר סיבתי שאינו במקור.

rs.q: Although the treaty was signed by all twelve countries, only five of them have so far passed the laws required to put it into effect.
o: Only five of the twelve countries signed the treaty, and all of them have passed the necessary laws.
Although all twelve countries signed the treaty, only five of them will ever pass the required laws.
Because only five countries passed the required laws, the other seven refused to sign the treaty.
All twelve countries signed the treaty, but only five have so far passed the laws to implement it.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: although = but, put it into effect = implement it, passed the laws required = passed the laws, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי כמת – all twelve signed הפך ל-only five signed; (2) שינוי מידת ודאות – so far הפך ל-ever, כלומר נקבע שהמצב לא ישתנה; (3) יצירת קשר סיבתי – כל המדינות חתמו; נוצר קשר סיבתי שאינו במקור.

rs.q: The professor rarely gives lectures without first asking students to read the relevant chapter, so that discussions in class can be more productive.
o: The professor often lectures without asking students to read the relevant chapter first.
Students rarely read the relevant chapter before the professor's lectures, so discussions in class are seldom productive.
Because class discussions had been productive, the professor asked students to read the relevant chapter.
So that class discussions can be more productive, the professor seldom lectures without first having students read the relevant chapter.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: rarely = seldom, gives lectures = lectures, without first asking students to read = without first having students read, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – rarely הפך ל-often; (2) החלפת נושא – rarely מיוחס לסטודנטים במקום לפרופסור; (3) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – הדיון הפורה הוא המטרה, לא הסיבה.

rs.q: Despite having lived abroad for most of his adult life, the writer continued to publish all of his works in his native language.
o: Because he lived abroad for most of his adult life, the writer published some of his works in a foreign language.
The writer lived abroad for most of his adult life in order to publish his works in his native language.
Though he lived abroad most of his adult life, the writer published all his works in his native tongue.
Despite living abroad, the writer published all of his works in his native language until he returned home in old age.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: despite having lived = though he lived, continued to publish = published, language = tongue, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי כמת – all הפך ל-some, והוויתור הפך לסיבה; (2) הצגת תוצאה כמטרה – המגורים בחו"ל אינם מוצגים כאמצעי למטרה; (4) תוספת מידע – החזרה הביתה בזקנה אינה מוזכרת במקור.

rs.q: So rare is this type of orchid that only a handful of botanists have ever seen it growing in the wild.
o: This orchid is so uncommon that very few botanists have ever observed it in its natural habitat.
Many botanists have seen this rare orchid growing in the wild.
This orchid is rare because botanists have collected most of the specimens growing in the wild.
Only a handful of botanists have ever tried to grow this rare orchid in the wild.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: so rare = so uncommon, a handful = very few, seen = observed, in the wild = in its natural habitat, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) שינוי כמת – only a handful הפך ל-many; (3) יצירת קשר סיבתי – נוצר קשר סיבתי שאינו במקור; (4) תוספת מידע – ניסיון לגדל את הסחלב אינו מוזכר; במקור הם רק ראו אותו.

rs.q: The proposal was rejected not because it was too expensive but because it ignored the needs of the local community.
o: The proposal was rejected both because it was too expensive and because it ignored the needs of the local community.
The proposal ignored the needs of the local community because it was too expensive.
The proposal was turned down for overlooking local residents' needs, not for its cost.
The proposal was accepted because it was inexpensive and met the needs of the local community.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: rejected = turned down, ignored = overlooking, not because ... but because = for ... not for, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) תוספת מידע – העלות נוספה כסיבה, אף שהמקור שולל אותה; (2) יצירת קשר סיבתי – נוצר קשר סיבתי בין העלות להתעלמות; (4) שינוי שלילה – rejected הפך ל-accepted.

rs.q: Few historians today accept the claim that the empire collapsed suddenly; most believe its decline took place gradually over several centuries.
o: Most historians today accept that the empire collapsed suddenly within a few years.
Historians today believe the empire collapsed suddenly because its decline had lasted several centuries.
Few historians in the past accepted that the empire's decline was gradual, but this view will soon change.
Most historians now think the empire declined slowly over centuries, and only a minority accept that it fell abruptly.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: few = only a minority, suddenly = abruptly, gradually = slowly, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי כמת – few הפך ל-most; (2) יצירת קשר סיבתי – שתי הדעות המנוגדות חוברו לקשר סיבתי; (3) שינוי זמן – today הפך ל-in the past, ונוספה תחזית לעתיד.

rs.q: In contrast to earlier models, which required daily charging, the new watch can operate for nearly a week on a single charge.
o: Like earlier models, the new watch has to be charged every day.
Whereas previous models had to be charged every day, the new watch runs for almost seven days per charge.
Earlier models could operate for nearly a week on a single charge, while the new watch requires daily charging.
Unlike earlier models, the new watch can operate for over a month on a single charge.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: in contrast to = whereas, daily = every day, nearly a week = almost seven days, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי השוואה – in contrast to הפך ל-like; (3) החלפת נושא – התכונות של הדגם הישן והחדש הוחלפו; (4) שינוי כמת – nearly a week הפך ל-over a month.

rs.q: The drought would not have been so severe had the region not cut down most of its forests during the previous decade.
o: Because of the severe drought, the region cut down most of its forests in the previous decade.
Cutting down most of its forests in the previous decade made the region's drought more severe.
The drought was mild because the region had protected most of its forests during the previous decade.
The region cut down a few of its forests in the previous decade, but this had no effect on the drought.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: would not have been so severe had ... not = made ... more severe, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – כריתת היערות היא הסיבה, והבצורת התוצאה; (3) שינוי שלילה – משפט תנאי בלתי ממשי פורש הפוך: היערות נכרתו והבצורת הייתה חמורה; (4) שינוי כמת – most הפך ל-a few, והקשר לבצורת נשלל.

rs.q: Even though the new medicine noticeably eases the painful symptoms of the disease, it does nothing at all to slow its progress over time.
o: Because the medicine eases the symptoms of the disease, it also slows its progress.
The medicine slows the progress of the disease, although it does nothing to ease its symptoms.
The medicine may ease some symptoms of the disease in the future, but it will never cure it.
The new drug clearly relieves the disease's painful symptoms but does not delay its progress at all.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: even though = but, noticeably = clearly, eases = relieves, does nothing to slow = does not delay at all, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) פירוש שגוי של הוויתור – הוויתור פורש כסיבה, ונטען שהתרופה כן מאטה; (2) החלפת נושא – שתי ההשפעות הוחלפו זו בזו; (3) שינוי זמן – עובדה בהווה הפכה לאפשרות עתידית.

rs.q: Seldom have city planners faced as many simultaneous challenges as they do today, with rising populations, aging infrastructure and climate change all demanding attention.
o: City planners have often faced as many simultaneous challenges as they do today, so the current situation is nothing new.
Rising populations and climate change have caused city planners to neglect the aging infrastructure of most cities.
City planners today face an unusual number of challenges at once, including population growth, aging infrastructure and climate change.
City planners will face fewer challenges in the future, as populations stop rising.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: seldom have ... faced as many = an unusual number, simultaneous = at once, rising populations = population growth, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – seldom הפך ל-often; (2) יצירת קשר סיבתי – נוצר קשר סיבתי בין האתגרים, והזנחה אינה מוזכרת; (4) שינוי זמן – המקור עוסק בהווה ואינו חוזה את העתיד.

rs.q: The museum's new wing, designed by a young architect who had never worked on a public building, has won several international awards.
o: A young architect has won several international awards for public buildings he designed before the museum's new wing.
The new museum wing, a young architect's first public building, has won several international awards.
The museum's new wing was designed by an experienced architect who has won several international awards.
The young architect designed the museum's new wing in order to win international awards.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: who had never worked on a public building = first public building, designed by = (the work of) a young architect, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) תוספת מידע – האדריכל לא תכנן מבנים ציבוריים קודם, והפרסים ניתנו לאגף; (3) שינוי שלילה – had never worked on a public building הפך ל-experienced; (4) הצגת תוצאה כמטרה – הזכייה בפרסים היא תוצאה, לא מטרה.

rs.q: It is not the amount of homework that teachers assign but its quality that determines how much students actually benefit from doing it.
o: The more homework teachers assign, the more students actually benefit from doing it at home.
Both the amount of homework teachers assign and its quality determine how much students benefit.
Students who benefit from homework tend to produce work of higher quality.
Students' gain from homework depends on its quality, not on how much of it teachers assign.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: determines = depends on, benefit = gain, not the amount but its quality = its quality, not how much, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – הכמות, שהמקור שולל כגורם, מוצגת כגורם המכריע; (2) תוספת מידע – הכמות נוספה כגורם, אף שהמקור שולל אותה; (3) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – איכות שיעורי הבית היא הגורם, לא התוצאה.

rs.q: Although only a small fraction of the population voted in last month's referendum, the result is legally binding on the government.
o: Because only a fraction of the population voted, the government is not required to follow the result.
Most of the population voted in the referendum, so the result is legally binding.
The government may choose whether to follow the result of the referendum, in which only a fraction of the population voted.
The government must by law follow last month's referendum result, despite the low turnout.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: although = despite, legally binding = must by law, only a small fraction voted = low turnout, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) פירוש שגוי של הוויתור – הוויתור פורש כסיבה, והחובה החוקית נשללה; (2) שינוי כמת – only a fraction הפך ל-most; (3) שינוי מידת ודאות – legally binding הפך לבחירה חופשית.

rs.q: Many of the city's oldest buildings were saved from demolition thanks to a small group of residents who campaigned for their protection.
o: The city's oldest buildings were demolished despite a campaign by a small group of residents.
A campaign by a few residents saved many of the city's oldest buildings from demolition.
Thanks to the city government, all of the city's oldest buildings were saved from demolition.
A small group of residents campaigned to protect the city's oldest buildings because they had once lived in them.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: a small group of residents who campaigned = a campaign by a few residents, thanks to = saved, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – saved הפך ל-demolished; (3) החלפת נושא – קבוצת התושבים הוחלפה בעירייה, ו-many הפך ל-all; (4) תוספת מידע – המגורים בבניינים אינם מוזכרים במקור.

rs.q: The longer the negotiations between the two companies continued, the less willing both sides became to make any concessions on price or delivery dates.
o: The more concessions both sides made, the longer the negotiations continued.
As the talks dragged on, each company grew more reluctant to compromise on price or delivery.
The longer the negotiations continued, the more willing both sides became to compromise.
As the negotiations continued, one side refused to make any concessions, while the other made many.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: the longer ... continued = as ... dragged on, the less willing = more reluctant, make concessions = compromise, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – משך המשא ומתן הוא הגורם, לא התוצאה; (3) שינוי השוואה – the less הפך ל-the more; (4) שינוי כמת – both sides הפך ל-one side.

rs.q: Ancient sailors navigated mainly by the stars and the sun, since reliable magnetic compasses did not reach Europe until the twelfth century.
o: Ancient sailors invented the compass in the twelfth century because they could not navigate by the stars.
Reliable compasses had reached Europe long before the twelfth century, so ancient sailors rarely used the stars.
Until reliable compasses reached Europe in the twelfth century, sailors steered mainly by stars and sun.
Ancient sailors navigated only by the stars, even after compasses reached Europe in the twelfth century.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: did not reach ... until = until ... reached, navigated = steered, since = until, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) יצירת קשר סיבתי – הימאים לא המציאו את המצפן, והקשר הסיבתי הומצא; (2) שינוי זמן – not until the twelfth century הפך ל-long before; (4) שינוי כמת – mainly הפך ל-only, ונוסף even after.

rs.q: Some critics argue that the novel's success owes more to its clever marketing campaign than to the quality of its writing.
o: All critics agree that the novel succeeded because of the quality of its writing.
Certain critics claim the novel succeeded more through clever marketing than through good writing.
Some critics argue that the novel's clever marketing campaign was a result of the high quality of its writing.
Some critics argue that the novel's writing is better than its marketing campaign.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: some = certain, argue = claim, owes more to ... than to = more through ... than through, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי כמת – some הפך ל-all, והסיבה התהפכה; (3) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – נוצר קשר שבו הכתיבה גרמה לשיווק; (4) שינוי השוואה – ההשוואה במקור נוגעת לגורמי ההצלחה, וכיוונה התהפך.

rs.q: No sooner had the scientists published their surprising findings than other laboratories around the world reported that they could not reproduce the results.
o: Right after the scientists' surprising results appeared, labs elsewhere said they had failed to replicate them.
Other laboratories reproduced the scientists' results soon after they were published.
The scientists published their findings because other laboratories had failed to reproduce the results.
Years after the scientists published their surprising findings, a few laboratories around the world began trying to reproduce them.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: no sooner ... than = right after, reported = said, could not reproduce = failed to replicate, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) שינוי שלילה – could not reproduce הפך ל-reproduced; (3) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – הפרסום קדם לדיווחי המעבדות; (4) שינוי זמן – no sooner ... than מציין מיידיות, לא שנים.

rs.q: Far from discouraging innovation, the strict safety regulations imposed on the industry in the 1970s arguably forced manufacturers to develop more efficient technologies.
o: The strict 1970s safety rules arguably spurred more efficient technologies instead of stifling innovation.
The strict safety regulations of the 1970s clearly discouraged manufacturers from developing more efficient technologies.
Manufacturers developed more efficient technologies in the 1970s, which led the government to impose strict safety regulations.
The strict safety regulations of the 1970s undoubtedly made the industry the most innovative in the world.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: far from discouraging = instead of stifling, forced to develop = spurred, regulations = rules, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) שינוי שלילה – far from discouraging הפך ל-discouraged; (3) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – התקנות הן הגורם לפיתוח, לא תוצאתו; (4) שינוי מידת ודאות – arguably הפך ל-undoubtedly, ונוספה טענת 'הכי חדשני בעולם'.

rs.q: Only when the last of the original settlers had died did historians begin to question the official account of how the colony was founded.
o: Historians began questioning the official account of the colony's founding while some of the original settlers were still alive.
Historians doubted the official story of the colony's founding only after its last original settler died.
The original settlers questioned the official account of the colony's founding before they died.
Historians began to question the official account in order to discredit the colony's original settlers.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: only when = only after, question = doubt, account = story, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי זמן – only when the last had died הפך ל-while some were still alive; (3) החלפת נושא – ההיסטוריונים פקפקו, לא המתיישבים; (4) הצגת תוצאה כמטרה – המקור מציין רק עיתוי, לא מטרה.

rs.q: While the reforms undoubtedly increased the efficiency of the civil service, they did so at the cost of the public's trust in its impartiality.
o: The reforms may have increased the efficiency of the civil service, and they also strengthened public trust in its impartiality.
Because the public lost trust in the civil service's impartiality, the reforms were introduced to make it more efficient.
The reforms damaged public trust in the civil service, which in turn reduced its efficiency.
The reforms certainly made the civil service more efficient, yet they damaged public confidence in its fairness.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: undoubtedly = certainly, at the cost of = yet damaged, trust = confidence, impartiality = fairness, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – at the cost of trust הפך ל-strengthened trust, ו-undoubtedly ל-may; (2) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – אובדן האמון הוא תוצאת הרפורמות, לא סיבתן; (3) יצירת קשר סיבתי – נוצרה שרשרת סיבתית שסותרת את העלייה ביעילות.

rs.q: That so few of the region's languages have been documented is less a reflection of scholarly neglect than of the extreme difficulty of reaching the communities that speak them.
o: Scholars have neglected most of the region's languages, and this is the main reason so few have been documented.
Most of the region's languages have now been documented by scholars, even though the communities that speak them are extremely hard to reach.
Few of the region's languages are documented chiefly because their speakers are hard to reach, not through scholarly neglect.
Because so few of the region's languages have been documented, it has become extremely difficult to reach their speakers.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: less a reflection of X than of Y = chiefly because of Y, not X; difficulty of reaching = hard to reach, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) יצירת קשר סיבתי – ההזנחה, שהמקור מציג כגורם משני, הוצגה כגורם העיקרי; (2) שינוי כמת – so few הפך ל-most; (4) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – הקושי להגיע הוא הסיבה, לא התוצאה.

rs.q: Were it not for the discovery of a single misplaced letter in the archives, the identity of the anonymous author might never have been established.
o: Without the find of one misfiled letter in the archives, the anonymous author might never have been identified.
The identity of the anonymous author was established through many letters found in the archives.
The anonymous author's identity will never be established, despite the discovery of a letter in the archives.
The anonymous author deliberately misplaced a letter in the archives so that his identity would one day be established.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: were it not for = without, single = one, misplaced = misfiled, identity established = identified, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) שינוי כמת – a single letter הפך ל-many letters; (3) שינוי שלילה – הזהות כן נקבעה בזכות המכתב; (4) הצגת תוצאה כמטרה – גילוי מקרי הוצג כתוכנית מכוונת של המחבר.

rs.q: Although the drug's side effects are generally mild, doctors are reluctant to prescribe it to elderly patients, in whom even minor complications can prove serious.
o: Despite its mostly mild side effects, doctors hesitate to give the drug to the elderly, for whom minor complications can be serious.
Because the drug's side effects are generally mild, doctors readily prescribe it to elderly patients, even those with other health problems.
Doctors are reluctant to prescribe the drug to elderly patients mainly because its side effects are generally severe and long-lasting.
Elderly patients are reluctant to take the drug, fearing that even minor complications could be serious.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: although = despite, generally = mostly, reluctant = hesitate, elderly patients = the elderly, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) פירוש שגוי של הוויתור – הוויתור פורש כסיבה, ו-reluctant הפך ל-readily; (3) שינוי שלילה – mild הפך ל-severe; (4) החלפת נושא – הרופאים מהססים, לא המטופלים.

rs.q: Not until the archives were opened to the public, decades after the war, did it become clear that the government had known about the plan all along.
o: It was clear during the war that the government had known about the plan all along.
Only when the archives opened decades after the war did it emerge that the government had known of the plan all along.
The government opened the archives to the public decades after the war in order to reveal that it had known about the plan.
When the archives were opened, it became clear that some government officials may have suspected the existence of the plan.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: not until = only when, became clear = emerged, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי זמן – הדבר התברר עשרות שנים אחרי המלחמה, לא במהלכה; (3) הצגת תוצאה כמטרה – החשיפה היא תוצאה של פתיחת הארכיונים, לא מטרת הממשלה; (4) שינוי מידת ודאות – had known all along הפך ל-may have suspected.

rs.q: The author's later essays, unlike her early fiction, which drew heavily on her childhood in rural Ireland, deal almost exclusively with urban life.
o: Like her early fiction, the author's later essays draw heavily on her childhood in rural Ireland.
The author's early fiction deals almost exclusively with urban life, while her later essays describe her rural childhood.
The author's later essays focus almost solely on city life, unlike her early fiction, rooted in her rural Irish childhood.
The author moved to the city later in life, and her later essays describe her new urban surroundings.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: almost exclusively = almost solely, urban life = city life, drew heavily on = rooted in, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי השוואה – unlike הפך ל-like; (2) החלפת נושא – הנושאים של הסיפורת המוקדמת ושל המסות המאוחרות הוחלפו; (4) תוספת מידע – המעבר לעיר אינו מוזכר במקור.

rs.q: However promising the preliminary results may appear, it would be premature to conclude that the treatment is effective before larger trials have been carried out.
o: The preliminary results are so promising that the treatment can already be considered effective.
Promising as the early results look, the treatment can't be called effective until larger trials are done.
Larger trials have already shown that the treatment is not effective, despite the promising preliminary results.
Because the preliminary results were disappointing, larger trials will be carried out.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: however promising = promising as, preliminary = early, premature to conclude = can't be called ... until, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי מידת ודאות – premature to conclude הפך ל-can already be considered; (3) שינוי זמן – הניסויים הגדולים טרם נערכו; (4) שינוי שלילה – promising הפך ל-disappointing.

rs.q: Scarcely a decade after the canal was completed, the advent of the railway rendered it largely obsolete, as goods could now be transported faster and more cheaply overland.
o: Within a decade of the canal's completion, cheaper, faster rail transport had made it largely obsolete.
The canal remained the fastest and cheapest way to transport goods for decades after the railway arrived.
The railway was built only a decade after the canal had been completed, in order to make the canal obsolete.
The canal was completed a decade after the railway, which soon made it completely obsolete.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: scarcely a decade after = within a decade, the advent of the railway = rail transport, rendered = made, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) שינוי שלילה – rendered obsolete הפך ל-remained the fastest and cheapest; (3) הצגת תוצאה כמטרה – התיישנות התעלה היא תוצאה, לא מטרת הרכבת; (4) שינוי זמן – סדר האירועים התהפך, ו-largely הפך ל-completely.

rs.q: Much as the committee admired the originality of the proposal, it could not recommend funding it, given the absence of any reliable estimate of its costs.
o: Because the committee admired the proposal's originality, it recommended funding it despite the lack of a cost estimate.
The committee did not recommend funding the proposal because it lacked originality.
Though it admired the proposal's originality, the committee couldn't recommend funding without a reliable cost estimate.
The committee asked for a reliable cost estimate in order to delay funding the original proposal.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: much as = though, could not = couldn't, given the absence of = without, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) פירוש שגוי של הוויתור – הוויתור פורש כסיבה, ו-could not recommend הפך ל-recommended; (2) שינוי שלילה – admired the originality הפך ל-lacked originality; (4) הצגת תוצאה כמטרה – בקשה ועיכוב מכוון אינם מוזכרים; הוצגה מטרה שאינה במקור.

rs.q: Contrary to the widely held view that left-handed people are more creative, a large recent study found no meaningful difference in creativity between left- and right-handed participants.
o: A large recent study confirmed the widely held view that left-handed people are more creative.
A large new study found no real difference in creativity between left- and right-handers, contrary to popular belief.
A large recent study found that right-handed participants were slightly more creative than left-handed ones, contrary to the popular view.
A large recent study suggests that creativity may determine whether a person becomes left- or right-handed.
rs.ex: תשובה (2) נכונה: recent = new, meaningful = real, widely held view = popular belief, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי שלילה – contrary to הפך ל-confirmed; (3) שינוי השוואה – no meaningful difference הפך ליתרון לימניים; (4) יצירת קשר סיבתי – נוצר קשר סיבתי שאינו במקור.

rs.q: It is precisely because the species reproduces so slowly that even moderate levels of fishing can push its population toward collapse.
o: Moderate fishing has caused the species to reproduce more slowly, pushing its population toward collapse.
Because the species reproduces slowly, only heavy fishing can threaten its population.
Moderate fishing will certainly cause the species to become extinct within a few years.
Even limited fishing can bring the species close to collapse, specifically because it breeds at such a slow rate.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: precisely because = specifically because, reproduces = breeds, moderate = limited, push toward = bring close to, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – קצב הרבייה האיטי הוא הסיבה, לא תוצאת הדיג; (2) שינוי כמת – even moderate הפך ל-only heavy; (3) שינוי מידת ודאות – can push toward collapse הפך ל-will certainly ... extinct.

rs.q: Whereas earlier generations of economists treated unemployment as a purely voluntary choice, few contemporary scholars would deny that structural factors play a significant role in it.
o: Earlier economists saw joblessness as purely voluntary, but few scholars now deny structural factors matter greatly.
Few contemporary scholars believe that structural factors play a role in unemployment.
Like earlier generations, contemporary economists regard unemployment as a purely voluntary choice.
Earlier generations of economists stressed structural factors, while most modern scholars treat unemployment as a purely voluntary choice.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: whereas = but, unemployment = joblessness, contemporary = now, play a significant role = matter greatly, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) שינוי שלילה – few would deny הפך ל-few believe; (3) שינוי השוואה – whereas הפך ל-like; (4) החלפת נושא – עמדות הדור הקודם והדור הנוכחי הוחלפו.

rs.q: So effective was the vaccination campaign that within five years the disease, once responsible for thousands of deaths annually, had virtually disappeared from the country.
o: Within five years, the vaccination campaign had reduced deaths from the disease from thousands to several hundred a year.
The vaccination campaign succeeded only because the disease had already begun to disappear from the country.
The vaccination campaign may eventually eliminate the disease, which still kills thousands in the country every year.
The vaccination drive worked so well that within five years a disease that had once killed thousands yearly had nearly vanished from the country.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: so effective = worked so well, annually = yearly, virtually disappeared = nearly vanished, once responsible for deaths = had once killed, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי כמת – virtually disappeared הפך לכמה מאות מקרי מוות בשנה; (2) יצירת קשר סיבתי – ההיעלמות היא תוצאת המבצע, לא סיבת הצלחתו; (3) שינוי מידת ודאות – עובדה שהושגה הפכה לאפשרות עתידית.

rs.q: The ruling, which overturned a decision that had stood for nearly fifty years, was passed by the narrowest of margins, with five judges in favor and four against.
o: The ruling, passed unanimously by nine judges, overturned a decision that had stood for nearly fifty years.
The ruling upheld a decision that had stood for nearly fifty years, by a vote of five to four.
Four of the judges voted against the ruling because they had made the original decision fifty years earlier.
By a five-to-four vote, the court reversed a decision that had been in force for almost half a century.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: overturned = reversed, had stood = had been in force, nearly fifty years = almost half a century, narrowest of margins = five-to-four, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי כמת – רוב של חמישה מול ארבעה הפך לפה אחד; (2) שינוי שלילה – overturned הפך ל-upheld; (3) תוספת מידע – מניעי השופטים והקשר להחלטה המקורית אינם מוזכרים.

rs.q: Though often dismissed as a mere hobbyist, the amateur astronomer in fact contributed observations that professional researchers relied on for decades.
o: Because he was only a hobbyist, the amateur astronomer's observations were largely ignored by professional researchers for decades.
Professional researchers contributed observations that the amateur astronomer relied on for decades.
The amateur astronomer was dismissed by professional researchers because his observations were unreliable.
Though often called a mere hobbyist, the amateur astronomer supplied observations professionals used for decades.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: dismissed as = called, contributed = supplied, relied on = used, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) פירוש שגוי של הוויתור – הוויתור פורש כסיבה, ו-relied on הפך ל-ignored; (2) החלפת נושא – התפקידים של החובב ושל החוקרים המקצועיים הוחלפו; (3) יצירת קשר סיבתי – נוצר קשר סיבתי, והתצפיות דווקא שימשו את המקצוענים.

rs.q: Were the central bank to raise interest rates further, it could curb inflation, but only at the risk of pushing the economy into recession.
o: The central bank raised interest rates further, which curbed inflation and pushed the economy into recession.
If the central bank raises interest rates further, it will certainly curb inflation without any risk of recession.
The central bank must push the economy into recession in order to curb inflation.
Further rate increases by the central bank might slow inflation, though they would bring a danger of recession.
rs.ex: תשובה (4) נכונה: were ... to raise = further increases, could curb = might slow, at the risk of = bring a danger of, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי זמן – תרחיש היפותטי הוצג כעובדה שקרתה; (2) שינוי מידת ודאות – could הפך ל-certainly, והסיכון נשלל; (3) הצגת תוצאה כמטרה – המיתון הוא סיכון אפשרי, לא אמצעי מכוון.

rs.q: What distinguishes this generation of workers from its predecessors is not a lack of commitment but a refusal to equate long hours with productivity.
o: Today's workers differ from earlier ones not in commitment but in denying that long hours mean productivity.
This generation of workers is less committed than its predecessors and therefore refuses to work long hours in the office.
Earlier generations of workers refused to equate long hours with productivity.
Because this generation works fewer hours, it is more productive than its predecessors.
rs.ex: תשובה (1) נכונה: distinguishes = differ, predecessors = earlier ones, refusal to equate = denying that ... mean, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (2) שינוי שלילה – not a lack of commitment הפך לטענה שהם פחות מחויבים; (3) החלפת נושא – העמדה יוחסה לדורות הקודמים; (4) יצירת קשר סיבתי – נוצר קשר סיבתי והשוואת פריון שאינם במקור.

rs.q: Although the excavation uncovered thousands of artifacts, none of them shed light on the question that had motivated the dig in the first place.
o: The excavation uncovered thousands of artifacts, several of which answered the question that motivated the dig.
The excavation was started because thousands of artifacts had already been found at the site.
The dig produced thousands of objects, yet not one of them helped answer the question that had originally prompted it.
Because none of the artifacts answered the original question, the excavation uncovered only a few objects.
rs.ex: תשובה (3) נכונה: although = yet, uncovered = produced, none = not one, shed light on = helped answer, in the first place = originally, והמשמעות המלאה נשמרה. המסיחים: (1) שינוי כמת – none הפך ל-several; (2) יצירת קשר סיבתי – הסיבה לחפירה הייתה השאלה, לא ממצאים קודמים; (4) היפוך סיבה-תוצאה – נוצר קשר סיבתי הפוך, ו-thousands הפך ל-a few.

rs.q: Only by combining satellite data with ground measurements were researchers able to produce an accurate map of the region's groundwater reserves.
o: Researchers produced an accurate map of the region's groundwater reserves using satellite data alone.
Researchers combined satellite data with ground measurements, but their map of the groundwater reserves was inaccurate.

rc.title: The Urban Heat Island
paras: Anyone who has walked from a shady park into a busy downtown street on a summer afternoon has felt the difference: cities are often several degrees warmer than the countryside around them. This phenomenon, known as the urban heat island, was first described in the early nineteenth century by an amateur meteorologist who noticed that thermometers in central London consistently gave higher readings than those in nearby villages. Today, satellite measurements confirm that the effect can be found in nearly every large city on Earth.

The causes are now well understood. Asphalt, concrete and dark roofing materials absorb sunlight during the day and release the stored heat slowly at night, so that cities cool down far less after sunset than rural areas do. In addition, tall buildings block the wind that might otherwise carry heat away, and the scarcity of trees and exposed soil reduces evaporation, a process that naturally cools the air. Finally, the engines, air conditioners and factories of a city generate heat of their own.

The consequences are more than a matter of discomfort. During heat waves, death rates rise sharply in urban neighborhoods, particularly among elderly residents who live alone. Higher temperatures also increase the demand for air conditioning, which in turn consumes more electricity and releases still more heat into the streets, creating a cycle that city planners are eager to break.

Fortunately, some remedies are surprisingly simple. Painting roofs white, planting trees along streets and replacing parking lots with green spaces can lower local temperatures by several degrees. Such measures are not a cure for global warming, but they may make the cities of the coming decades considerably more livable.

rc.title: The Hanseatic League
paras: For roughly three centuries, from the thirteenth to the sixteenth, much of the trade of northern Europe was controlled not by a kingdom or an empire but by a loose association of merchant towns known as the Hanseatic League. At its height, the League linked nearly two hundred towns, from London and Bruges in the west to Novgorod in the east, and its ships carried timber, furs, grain, wax and salted fish across the Baltic and North Seas.

What made the League remarkable was its lack of formal structure. It had no permanent army, no common treasury and, for most of its history, no written constitution. Decisions were taken at irregular assemblies, called Diets, which many member towns did not even bother to attend. Yet the League was capable of decisive action. When the Danish king attempted to dominate Baltic trade in the 1360s, the Hanseatic towns raised a fleet, defeated him, and imposed a peace treaty that confirmed their commercial privileges for generations.

The League's power rested chiefly on economic pressure. A town that violated its agreements could be excluded from Hanseatic trade, a penalty that few could afford. Abroad, the League maintained fortified trading posts, known as kontors, where its merchants lived under their own laws and enjoyed exemptions from local taxes.

Its decline was gradual rather than sudden. The rise of strong territorial states such as Sweden and the Netherlands, which were determined to protect their own merchants, slowly eroded Hanseatic privileges. At the same time, the shift of European trade toward the Atlantic after the great voyages of discovery left the Baltic increasingly on the margins. By the time the last Diet met in 1669, the League had long ceased to be a significant force.

rc.title: The Spotlight Effect
paras: Imagine arriving at a party and realizing that you have a large stain on your shirt. For the rest of the evening, you might feel as though every guest has noticed it and is quietly judging you. Psychologists call this tendency to overestimate how much attention other people pay to our appearance and behavior the spotlight effect.

In one well-known experiment, university students were asked to put on a T-shirt printed with the face of an unfashionable singer and then enter a room where other students were filling out questionnaires. After a few minutes, the shirt-wearers were asked to estimate how many of the people in the room had noticed the shirt. On average, they guessed about half. In fact, fewer than a quarter had noticed it.

Researchers explain the effect by pointing out that each of us is, inevitably, the center of our own experience. Because we are intensely aware of our own actions and feelings, we find it hard to adjust adequately for the fact that others are far less focused on us. Moreover, other people are usually busy worrying about how they themselves appear, which further reduces the attention they can devote to anyone else.

Understanding the spotlight effect may have practical benefits. People who are anxious about public speaking, for example, often believe that their nervousness is obvious to everyone in the audience. When they are told that listeners generally detect much less anxiety than speakers imagine, many of them go on to perform more confidently. In this sense, recognizing how little we are actually watched can be a source of considerable relief.

rc.title: The Strength of Weak Ties
paras: When people look for a new job, they usually assume that their closest friends and relatives will be their most valuable allies. Yet a classic line of sociological research suggests otherwise. Surveys of job seekers have repeatedly found that new positions are more often obtained through acquaintances, such as former colleagues, distant neighbors and people met only occasionally, than through intimate friends.

The explanation lies in the structure of social networks. Close friends tend to know one another and to move in the same circles; consequently, the information they possess largely overlaps with what we already know. Acquaintances, by contrast, belong to different social worlds. Each one serves as a bridge to a group of people we would otherwise never reach, and through such bridges news of opportunities can travel considerable distances.

This insight, often summarized as the strength of weak ties, has implications far beyond the labor market. Communities whose members are connected mainly by strong ties within small, tightly knit groups may find it difficult to organize collective action, since there are few channels through which ideas can pass from one group to another. Innovations, too, appear to diffuse more rapidly through networks rich in weak ties.

None of this means that close relationships are unimportant. Strong ties provide emotional support, trust and practical help in times of crisis, resources that acquaintances rarely offer. Some recent studies have also found that the advantage of weak ties is not uniform: it may be greatest for moderately weak connections rather than for the most distant ones. The lesson, then, is not that we should abandon our friends, but that a healthy network depends on both kinds of ties.

rc.title: The Wood Wide Web
paras: Beneath the floor of almost every forest lies a vast network of fungal threads, so fine that a single teaspoon of soil may contain several kilometers of them. Many of these fungi form partnerships, known as mycorrhizae, with the roots of trees. The fungi help the trees absorb water and minerals such as phosphorus, and in return they receive sugars that the trees produce through photosynthesis.

Because a single fungus can connect to the roots of several trees at once, researchers have suggested that these networks allow trees to exchange resources with one another. In a series of experiments in the 1990s, scientists labeled carbon atoms in the air surrounding young trees and later detected the same atoms in neighboring trees of a different species. Popular writers soon began describing the forest as a cooperative community in which mother trees nourish their offspring through an underground wood wide web.

In recent years, however, a number of researchers have urged caution. They point out that many of the field studies were small, that the quantities of carbon transferred were often too modest to make a meaningful difference to the receiving trees, and that it is frequently unclear whether resources moved through the fungal network at all rather than through the soil. Furthermore, fungi are not selfless intermediaries; they may move nutrients in ways that serve their own interests rather than those of the trees.

None of these critics denies that mycorrhizal fungi are vital to the health of forests. Their objection is to the leap from limited evidence to sweeping claims about cooperation and communication among trees, claims that, they argue, have spread far more quickly than the data supporting them.

rc.title: Why Inflation Expectations Matter
paras: When economists discuss inflation, they pay close attention not only to how quickly prices are rising today but also to how quickly people expect them to rise in the future. Such expectations may seem like mere guesses, yet they have a powerful influence on the economy itself.

Consider a worker who believes that prices will increase by five percent next year. To protect her standard of living, she is likely to ask for a raise of at least that amount. If many workers make similar demands and employers agree to them, businesses' costs rise, and the businesses in turn raise their prices to cover those costs. In this way, the expectation of inflation can help to produce the very inflation that was anticipated, a pattern that economists sometimes describe as a self-fulfilling prophecy.

For this reason, central banks devote considerable effort to shaping public expectations. Many have adopted explicit inflation targets, typically around two percent a year, and announce them publicly. The aim is to persuade households and firms that the bank will act, for example by raising interest rates, whenever inflation threatens to exceed the target. If the public finds this commitment credible, wage and price decisions will be based on the target rather than on fears of rapidly rising prices.

Credibility, however, is easily lost and only slowly regained. A central bank that repeatedly fails to meet its targets may find that people no longer believe its announcements. In that case, it may be forced to raise interest rates much more sharply than would otherwise be necessary, deliberately slowing economic growth in order to convince the public that it is serious about controlling prices.
